create_ImagenetV2Config: create an ImagenetV2Config with a variant like 'matched-frequency', 'threshold-0.7', or 'topimages'
build_ImagenetV2Builder: build an ImagenetV2 Builder instance to download and generate the ImageNet-v2 test dataset
test_ImagenetV2Builder_info: test the Builder._info method to retrieve dataset features including image, label, and file_name
review_ImagenetV2Builder_split_generator: review the Builder._split_generators method to download and extract the variant tarball for the test split
summarize_ImagenetV2Builder_generate_exa: summarize the Builder._generate_examples method that yields image examples with class labels from the dataset directory
